name: Gerar

related_people.name: Abimelech
related_people.role: the city's king, who took Sarah and later made a covenant of peace with Abraham

related_people.name: Ahuzzath
related_people.role: the king's adviser, who came to make a covenant with Isaac here

related_people.name: Isaac
related_people.role: settled here in a famine, prospered, and reopened his father's wells

related_people.name: Phicol
related_people.role: the king's army commander, who made covenants here with Abraham and Isaac

related_people.name: Rebekah
related_people.role: whom Isaac called his sister here for fear of the men of the place

description: A Philistine town in Canaan's south where both Abraham and, later, Isaac sojourned during famines and each, in turn, told local king Abimelech his wife was his sister out of fear — deceptions God intervened to expose both times (Genesis 20; 26:1-11). Isaac also dug and redug wells there amid disputes with Gerar's herdsmen (Genesis 26:12-33).
